name: coopetition-gym-v1
description: Training results from the NeurIPS 2026 Coopetition-Gym benchmark campaign. Contains 25,708 JSON files, each recording the outcome of training one of 16 reinforcement learning algorithms, 7 game-theoretic oracles, 2 heuristic baselines, or 101 constant-action policies on one of 20 mixed-motive multi-agent environments under one of three reward configurations (private, integrated, cooperative) with one of seven random seeds. The dataset supports reproducibility of the paper 'Reward-Type Ablation Reveals Mechanism-Dependent Algorithm Rankings in Mixed-Motive Multi-Agent Evaluation'.

rai:dataCollection: The dataset was generated by running simulation experiments in the Coopetition-Gym environment suite. No human subjects were involved; all data is synthetic output from seeded multi-agent reinforcement learning trajectories. The simulation code is open-sourced at https://github.com/vikpant/strategic-coopetition.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: No preprocessing was applied; the released files are the raw orchestrator output. The companion analysis pipeline (experiments.analyze) performs cross-seed aggregation at analysis time.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is a factorial experimental design and does not sample from a population. Biases present are (a) algorithm design choices by the implementer (documented in experiments.algorithms), (b) environment design choices by the benchmark authors (documented in coopetition_gym), and (c) 62 NaN-return entries from documented training instabilities (21 MASAC TR-3, 21 MADDPG/MATD3/M3DDPG cooperative, 20 MADDPG sensitivity) retained for transparency. The seed set (99-105) is arbitrary but fixed.
rai:useCases: Reproducibility of the NeurIPS 2026 paper; development of algorithms tuned for mixed-motive settings; meta-analysis across reward configurations; failure-mode characterization; uncertainty quantification; educational material for reward-type ablation methodology.
rai:dataLimitation: The dataset should not be used to train policies for deployment in actual business settings without additional domain-specific validation. The validated case studies (Samsung-Sony, Renault-Nissan, Apache, Apple) are abstract models of historical partnerships; they do not authorize operational use. The dataset does not reflect empirical human cooperative behavior.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive: enables reproducible research on mixed-motive MARL evaluation methodology. Negative: policies derived from this dataset under integrated-reward configurations can, in principle, rationally harm partners; the behavioral audit (coopetition-gym-audit) empirically bounds this vulnerability. Users training on this dataset should audit derived policies for the exploitation-gradient condition described in the paper Appendix F.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The v1 dataset is frozen for reproducibility. Corrections will be recorded in the GitHub repository's CHANGELOG.md. Extensions will be released as versioned successors (v2, v3, ...) with their own datasheets. Contact vik.pant@utoronto.ca or open an issue at https://github.com/vikpant/strategic-coopetition/issues.

distribution.name: unified_dataset.tar.gz
distribution.description: gzip-compressed tarball containing all 25,708 training-result JSON files organized by reward configuration.

distribution.name: training-json-files
distribution.description: The individual JSON result files within the tarball. Filename encodes (algorithm, environment, seed); parent directory encodes reward configuration.

recordSet.name: training-results
recordSet.description: One record per training experiment. The tuple (algorithm, environment, training_seed, reward_type) uniquely identifies a record.

field.name: algorithm
field.description: Algorithm name. One of 16 training algorithms, 7 game-theoretic oracles, 2 heuristic baselines (Random, TitForTat), or 101 constant-action policies (Constant_00 through Constant_100).

field.name: environment
field.description: Environment ID from Coopetition-Gym. One of 20 environments across 4 TR tiers.

field.name: training_seed
field.description: Random seed used for training. One of {99, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105}.

field.name: status
field.description: Experiment completion status. Typically 'success' for released files.

field.name: tr_mode
field.description: Technical report tier label: tr1 (interdependence), tr2 (trust), tr3 (collective action), tr4 (reciprocity).

field.name: mean_return
field.description: Mean episodic return across 100 evaluation episodes after training. Primary performance metric.

field.name: std_return
field.description: Standard deviation of episodic returns across evaluation.

field.name: mean_cooperation_rate
field.description: Mean fraction of endowment contributed per step during evaluation.

field.name: mean_final_trust
field.description: Mean trust level at final episode step, averaged over agents and evaluation episodes.
